paper.title: DCM Bandits: Learning to Rank with Multiple Clicks

unmapped: Dependent click model: ranked list of K out of L items; independent Bernoulli item attraction probabilities and position termination probabilities; reward 1 - prod(1 - v(k) w(a_k)) is unobserved, only clicks are observed
Learner knows the order of the termination probabilities (not their values)
settings.definition_quote: We refer to our learning problem as a \emph{DCM bandit}. Formally, we define it as a tuple $B = (E, P_\textsc{w}, P_\textsc{v}, K)$ ... The learning agent also receives a \emph{binary reward} $\rnd{r}_t$, which is \emph{unobserved}.

settings.name_in_paper: DCM bandits, lower-bound class B_LB (lower bound)
unmapped: Dependent click model with unobserved satisfaction reward; only clicks observed
settings.definition_quote: Our lower bound is derived on the following class of problems. The ground set are $L$ items $E = [L]$ and $K$ of these items are optimal ... termination probabilities are identical, $\bar{v}(k) = \gamma$

bound.expression_latex: \sum_{e = i + 1}^L \frac{(1 + \eps) \Delta_{e, i} (1 + \log(1 / \Delta_{e, i}))}{\kl{\bar{w}(e)}{\bar{w}(i)}} (\log n + 3 \log \log n) + C

symbols.i: number of top positions in the cascade reward, i in [K]
symbols.L_items: number of items in ground set

conditions: attraction and termination weights independent Bernoulli
tuning: exploration log t + 3 log log t

source.label: thm:cascade regret
source.quote: For any $i \in [K]$ and $\eps > 0$, the expected $n$-step cascade regret of $\dcmklucb$ is bounded as R_i(n) \leq \sum_{e = i + 1}^L \frac{(1 + \eps) \Delta_{e, i} (1 + \log(1 / \Delta_{e, i}))}{\kl{\bar{w}(e)}{\bar{w}(i)}} (\log n + 3 \log \log n) + C, where $C = i L \frac{C_2(\eps)}{n^{\beta(\eps)}} + 7 i \log \log n$

results.notes: Bound on the auxiliary 'cascade regret' R_i(n), not the DCM regret; recorded as quantity other. Paper's K (list length) is m, L is number of items.

bound.expression_latex: \frac{\gamma}{\alpha} \sum_{e = K + 1}^L \frac{(1 + \eps) \Delta_{e, K} (1 + \log(1 / \Delta_{e, K}))}{\kl{\bar{w}(e)}{\bar{w}(K)}} (\log n + 3 \log \log n) + C

symbols.alpha_dcm: (1 - p_max)^(K-1), p_max the maximal attraction probability
symbols.L_items: number of items in ground set

conditions: all termination probabilities equal to gamma

source.label: thm:simple upper bound
source.quote: Let $\bar{v}(k) = \gamma$ for all $k \in [K]$ and $\eps > 0$. Then the expected $n$-step regret of $\dcmklucb$ is bounded as R(n) \leq \frac{\gamma}{\alpha} \sum_{e = K + 1}^L ... (\log n + 3 \log \log n) + C, where $C = \frac{\gamma}{\alpha} \left(K L \frac{C_2(\eps)}{n^{\beta(\eps)}} + 7 K \log \log n\right)$

results.notes: Regret defined via expected rewards of fixed optimal list, so pseudo-regret. Paper's K is m.

bound.expression_latex: (1 + \eps) \sum_{i = 1}^K \frac{\bar{v}(i) - \bar{v}(i + 1)}{\alpha} \sum_{e = i + 1}^L \frac{\Delta_{e, i} (1 + \log(1 / \Delta_{e, i}))}{\kl{\bar{w}(e)}{\bar{w}(i)}} (\log n + 3 \log \log n) + C

conditions: termination probabilities ordered v(1) >= ... >= v(K) and the order is known

source.label: thm:upper bound
source.quote: Let $\bar{v}(1) \geq \ldots \geq \bar{v}(K)$ and $\eps > 0$. Then the expected $n$-step regret of $\dcmklucb$ is bounded as R(n) \leq (1 + \eps) \sum_{i = 1}^K \frac{\bar{v}(i) - \bar{v}(i + 1)}{\alpha} \sum_{e = i + 1}^L \frac{\Delta_{e, i} (1 + \log(1 / \Delta_{e, i}))}{\kl{\bar{w}(e)}{\bar{w}(i)}} (\log n + 3 \log \log n) + C

results.notes: Reduces to Theorem 1 when all termination probabilities equal.

symbols.p_attr: common attraction probability of optimal items

conditions: instances B_LB: K optimal items with attraction p, others p - Delta
consistency defined via E[T_n(e)] = o(n^a) for suboptimal items

source.label: thm:lower bound
source.quote: For any DCM bandit $B_\mathrm{LB}$, the regret of any consistent algorithm is bounded from below as \liminf_{n \to \infty} \frac{R(n)}{\log n} \geq \gamma \alpha \frac{(L - K) \Delta}{\kl{p - \Delta}{p}}.
